answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, and tie that stake to a hardware-bound identity: a ferrous key sealed in a TPM-like enclave that cannot be cloned cheaply. A new identity starts as a faint ember - it may only take tiny jobs until peers attest its work over weeks. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand enclaves and months of honest history, while one honest agent pays almost nothing beyond its single stake.
